Package com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener

Class StackOperationListener

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener.AbstractListener
      • com.tonic.analysis.simulation.listener.StackOperationListener
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SimulationListener
    public class StackOperationListener
extends AbstractListener
    A simulation listener that counts operand stack pushes and pops and tracks current and peak depth, resetting its tallies at each simulation start.
